title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Combining the answers a large language model (LLM) samples for a question into one decision is a test-time information fusion problem, usually solved by majority voting. Voting is unreliable on difficult questions, where the sampled answers share correlated errors, so the wrong answer can win and drawing more samples makes the decision worse. Selecting a candidate by reading a correctness signal from the model's hidden states is a promising alternative, but its accuracy varies across models and tasks, and no measure indicates when it can be trusted. In this paper, we propose CASE (Correctness-Axis SElection), a dynamic selection combiner that trains a linear gate on the answer-token hidden state and selects the highest-scoring candidate. Its main contribution is decodability, a leakage-free measure of how well the gate ranks a question's correct candidates above its incorrect ones, which predicts whether hidden-state selection will outpe

translated_title: 一种可解码性标准预测大型语言模型中隐藏状态选择何时优于多数投票
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17124v1 公告类型：新 摘要：将大型语言模型（LLM）针对一个问题采样的多个答案合并为一个决策，是测试时信息融合问题，通常通过多数投票解决。在困难问题上，投票可能不可靠，因为采样答案共享相关错误，导致错误答案可能获胜，且增加采样数量会使决策更差。通过从模型隐藏状态读取正确性信号来选择候选答案是一种有前景的替代方案，但其准确性因模型和任务而异，且没有衡量指标表明何时可信任。在本文中，我们提出CASE（正确性轴选择），一种动态选择组合器，它在答案令牌的隐藏状态上训练一个线性门控，并选择得分最高的候选。其主要贡献是可解码性，一种无泄漏的度量，衡量门控将问题正确候选排在不正确候选之上的能力，这能预测隐藏状态选择是否优于多数投票。
tldr: 本文提出CASE方法和可解码性度量，用于预测并实现隐藏状态选择在大型语言模型答案融合中优于多数投票的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CASE and a decodability metric to predict when hidden-state selection outperforms majority voting in LLM answer fusion.
